reason: A is the stronger proposal because it isolates lattice distortion from configurational entropy and cohesive energy, specifies diffusion and phase-stability measurements, and offers a more decisive mechanistic test, whereas B confounds entropy, composition, cohesion, and distortion in an HEA-versus-binary comparison that largely repeats prior work. A’s premise that distortion necessarily raises vacancy-formation energy is not universally valid—local strain can lower it—but that uncertainty is directly testable and does not outweigh its superior experimental discrimination.
